name: Classic veteran
direction: Closest to the original: brown leather jerkin, dark trousers, short brown beard, stronger readable face, worn bracers and narrow belt. Add careful material detail while retaining the original silhouette.

name: Mail and leather
direction: A practical brown leather vest over a muted dark steel chainmail shirt; small shoulder guards, leather wrist wraps, dark boots. Keep the original brown hair and beard, compact sturdy body.

name: Mercenary
direction: A weathered mercenary in dark brown brigandine with a few small dull steel rivets, one restrained shoulder plate, burgundy waist sash, brown beard. Grounded, practical armour.

name: Frontier fighter
direction: Brown leather padded jacket, tan inner shirt, dark wrist guards, sturdy trousers and worn boots, small belt pouch. Rugged brown-haired bearded fighter; no bulky fur.

name: Iron guard
direction: Brown leather torso with a restrained dark iron chest insert and small squared pauldrons, dark steel bracers, narrow leather belt. Exposed brown-haired bearded head, mature practical fighter.

name: Battle worn
direction: Original brown warrior outfit refined into layered leather straps, a small pale old facial scar, muted red cloth at waist, darker boots. A seasoned grounded fighter with a strong face.

name: Light vanguard
direction: Fitted brown leather cuirass, grey cloth sleeves, small metal knee guards and dark wrist wraps. Compact athletic masculine body, original brown hair and beard. Clear silhouette and subtle metal highlights.

name: Bronze veteran
direction: Dark chocolate leather armour with sparse tarnished bronze fasteners and bracers, charcoal trousers, dull rust shoulder cloth. Original brown-haired bearded identity, restrained earthy palette.

name: Dark adventurer
direction: Charcoal-brown fitted gambeson, brown leather shoulder yoke and belt, muted olive undershirt, sturdy boots. Mature brown-haired bearded warrior, elegant understated material separation.
